title: 名越稔洋离开世嘉后创立的工作室 Nagoshi Studio 因网易削减资金而关闭
content:
Nagoshi Studio closes as Netease cuts its funding
Business
Console
PC
News
Toshihiro Nagoshi's post-Sega game studio, Nagoshi Studio, shuts down after NetEase funding cuts
Founded in 2021, the studio was working on a game funded by NetEase announced just under a year ago, but the studio has reportedly collapsed.
Imran Khan
,
Contributing Editor
November 2, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
via NetEase
It was just last December when Nagoshi Studio unveiled
Gang of Dragon
, a spiritual successor to the Nagoshi-created series Like a Dragon/Yakuza from Sega,
at The Game Awards
in Los Angeles. But since the announcement, NetEase reportedly cut funding on the game's development, and the studio itself has been dissolved according to
a report of company dissolutions by Kanpo
, the official government gazette of Japan.
Toshihiro Nagoshi left Sega in 2021 as its chief creative officer, as well as head of the Yakuza developer Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. That same year, Nagoshi founded Nagoshi Studio under NetEase, revealing
Gang of Dragon
four years later. This past March,
Bloomberg reported that NetEase pulled back funding on the game
after the studio required addition funding of ¥7 billion ($44.5 million) to finish the game, also coinciding with NetEase looking to pull back from gaming.
Other studios have recently split from NetEase, such as
Goichi Suda's Grasshopper Manufacture
and
Anchor Point Studios
, but Nagoshi Studio joins the far larger list of studios under NetEase that
suffered layoffs
or
shut down entirely
. NetEase has not officially canceled
Gang of Dragon
, but it is unclear if there is any appetite at NetEase to take the project over the finish line.
Related:
Roblox growth slumps, but the company is betting big on AI to compensate
Nagoshi has not issued any public statements since
Gang of Dragon
was revealed in December. This past summer, the Nagoshi Studio YouTube channel was deleted, then restored with all videos made private, including the reveal trailer for
Gang of Dragon
.
